## Checklist for a new or changed example

- [ ] **Real domain**: the product would exist without Clerk, and Clerk solves its auth better than hand-rolling.
- [ ] **One hero feature** in the title and in the registry entry.
- [ ] **Try in < 60 s**: public demo with "Try as demo user".
- [ ] **Readable in an afternoon**: ~2k lines of app code or fewer.
- [ ] **Real backend** verifying tokens.
- [ ] Own Clerk application; `.env.example` complete.
- [ ] `README.md` and `README.es.md`.
- [ ] `project.mdx` present; `pnpm registry:check` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm lint` and `pnpm typecheck` pass.
